_comment: Full copy for every body field is in research-to-copy-map.golden.md. This file settles the
MECHANICS: document ids, which write primitive each field uses, key derivation, and the
A NEW SCRIPT. scripts/seed-page-singletons.ts is NOT extended — it uses createOrReplace,
which silently reverts every editor change on each run. This script must not import from it,
mention any exhibitor type inside it, or contain the string createOrReplace anywhere.
invariants: createIfNotExists for every document. Never createOrReplace.
setIfMissing for every field patch. Never .set() — an editor's correction always wins.
No seeded value is an empty string. A blank field is indistinguishable from a bug.
No seeded status is 'confirmed'. Nothing ships as committee-confirmed fact.

Every portable-text _key is deterministic, derived from the block's own slug and index. No randomUUID, no Math.random, no nanoid — a random key makes the seed non-idempotent and every re-run produces a spurious revision.
Re-running the script changes no document revision and creates no duplicate. Proven against the real dataset by check-seed-idempotent.mjs.
The script never writes nationalShow.exhibitorStages — see exhibitorStages-reconciliation.golden.md.
The script never writes entryFormFile or entryFormUrl. There is no entry form; seeding a placeholder file would be the exact harm this mission exists to prevent.

keyDerivation._note: Deterministic and human-readable. Re-running produces byte-identical blocks, so setIfMissing is a no-op and the revision does not move.

fields.title: Exhibitor Information
fields.intro: Everything we currently know about entering plants in the 19th South African National Orchid Show — and, just as importantly, everything that is not settled yet. Most of what follows is established practice at orchid shows internationally, offered so the show committee has something to correct rather than a blank page. None of it is SAOC policy until the committee says so.
fields.pendingLabel: To be confirmed by the show committee
fields.researchLabel: Researched international show practice — a starting point for the show committee, not yet SAOC policy
fields.questionLabel: Open question for the show committee — we could not establish this
fields.keyDatesNote: None of these dates are set yet. The show committee will confirm them and they will be published here. Do not make travel or freight arrangements against anything on this page.
fields.keyDates: 6 showExhibitorDate items — see research-to-copy-map.golden.md. Every one status 'pending'. Every dateNote a string, never a date.
fields.entryFormPendingNote: The entry form for the 19th National Show has not been published yet. When the show committee releases it, it will be available for download here. In the meantime, contact the council if you intend to exhibit.
fields.classes: { heading, body } — see copy map. Contains no class code.
fields.judging: { heading, body } — see copy map. Restates no judging criterion.
fields.permits: { heading, body } — see copy map. The CITES block.
fields.contactNote: If you are planning to exhibit and need an answer before these pages are complete, contact the council directly and we will put you in touch with the show committee.
